an4.38:1.1: panuṇṇapaccekasacco bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano passaddhakāyasaṃkhāro paṭilīnoti vuccati.
an4.38:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni seyyathīdaṃ
an4.38:1.4: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā
an4.38:1.5: sabbāni tāni nuṇṇāni honti panuṇṇāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni
an4.38:1.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti.
an4.38:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti bhavesanā pahīnā hoti brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā hoti
an4.38:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
an4.38:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.38:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṃkhāro hoti.
an4.38:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo dālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ kato āyatiṃanuppādadhammo
an4.38:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭilīno hoti. evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu
